name: realtor-riverside-editor
description: The AI Editor, Riverside engine. The agent talks to Claude in plain English; Claude edits the video DIRECTLY in Riverside (on the agent's own account) — cuts, filler words, dead air, Magic Audio, a bare-minimum grade, captions, B-roll, a hook card + CTA, chapters — with every change verifiable (revision diffs) and no per-edit AI credits. Long-form and short-form in one tool, plus native PUBLISHING to YouTube / Shorts / TikTok / Instagram / Facebook / LinkedIn / X with scheduling, gated behind the agent's explicit yes. Same brand, same house rules, same 80/20 hand-off as the Descript editor (Plugin 6) — a different engine, the same editor. Requires Plugin 1 (the Brain) set up first, plus a Riverside connection.
